req.title: Return all players sorted by id
req.statement: The system shall list players in insertion (id) order on GET /players/.
triggers: return all players sorted by id

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-031 requires GET /players/ to return all players sorted by insertion (id) order with HTTP 200. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — verify status 200, all 26 rows returned, and id-ascending order matches the known seeded UUIDs; (2) negative NEG — verify a bad HTTP method (POST without body) returns 4xx, not 2xx; (3) boundary BVA — verify the first and last player in the sorted list match the exact seeded boundary UUIDs (first inserted id = 97da2849..., last = 77a3ac92...) and that the list length is exactly 26; (4) STC — verify that after inserting a new player via POST, GET /players/ returns 27 records with the new player appended last (insertion order preserved); (5) DT — verify every field of the first returned player matches the seeded row exactly, catching field-mapping mutations.

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_26_records_in_id_order():

    assert isinstance(data, list)

        '3a34bd83-441a-4abe-9f6f-210579e1be4b',
        '595b47db-fe68-441b-9ce1-7d2f2bb362a5',
        'baee3972-0bb4-4450-bf9f-2284666a65e5',
        '2b515093-76be-4c72-98de-729c368f7ddb',
        'dd957ea5-fa5d-4250-9abf-e7b2420479bc',
        '428488a6-202f-41d6-81d0-53b91fcac8c8',
        '0654d83f-f48d-4ea9-847c-8a88ffc4aad6',
        'b24f74ac-bb2d-4e87-97ea-679b802116dd',
        'e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6',

    for i, expected_id in enumerate(expected_ids):

tests.name: test_get_all_players_insertion_order_preserved_after_post
preconditions: POST /players/ endpoint available to add a new player
actions: POST a new player with squadNumber=99
GET /players/ and verify new player appears last (index 26)
DELETE the new player to restore state
expected: New player is at index 26 (last position, insertion order)
All prior 26 players remain in their original positions
trace: R-PLAYER-031: insertion order maintained after new record added
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_insertion_order_preserved_after_post():
    new_player = {
        'firstName': 'Test', 'lastName': 'Player', 'squadNumber': 99,
        'position': 'Goalkeeper', 'starting11': False
    }
    post_r = client.post('/players/', json=new_player)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    new_id = post_r.json()['id']
    try:
        r = client.get('/players/')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        data = r.json()
        assert len(data) == 27
        assert data[0]['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
        assert data[26]['id'] == new_id
        assert data[26]['squadNumber'] == 99
        assert data[26]['firstName'] == 'Test'
    finally:
        client.delete('/players/squadnumber/99')
    r2 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert len(r2.json()) == 26

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_exact_field_values_first_record():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert len(data) >= 1
    p = data[0]
    assert p['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    assert p['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert p['middleName'] is None or p['middleName'] == '' or p.get('middleName') in (None, '')
    assert p['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert p['dateOfBirth'] == '1901-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert p['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert p['position'] == 'Defensive Midfield'
    assert p['abbrPosition'] == 'GK'
    assert p['team'] == 'Manchester City'
    assert p['league'] == 'Serie A'
    assert p['starting11'] == False
